tasks.label: Run Backend
tasks.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn pitwall.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765

tasks.label: Run Frontend
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run dev

tasks.label: TS Type Check
tasks.command: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Python Import Test
tasks.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python -c "from pitwall.core.event_bus import TelemetryEventBus; from pitwall.core.models import Topics; from pitwall.core.transport import WebSocketTransport, EventBusBridge; from pitwall.hud.overlay_manager import OverlayManager; from pitwall.state.store import StateStore; from pitwall.api.ws import WebSocketHub; print('All backend imports OK')"

tasks.label: Python Tests
tasks.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -80; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Python Tests Verbose
tasks.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/test_integration.py tests/test_store.py --tb=long -v 2>&1 | tail -120; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Cleanup Files
tasks.command: rm -f frontend/src/styles.css.bak bello CODE_REVIEW_FINDINGS.md FIXES_SUMMARY.md IMPROVEMENTS_50.md && echo 'Cleanup done'

tasks.label: Git Commit Push
tasks.command: git add -A && git status && git commit -m 'refactor: clean up dead code, fix unused imports, wire normalizer into WS pipeline, optimize state store caching and parallel WS broadcasts' && git push origin codex/design-pit-wall-application-architecture

tasks.label: Push Current Branch
tasks.command: git push origin HEAD && echo 'PUSH_OK'

tasks.label: Merge to Main and Tag
tasks.command: CURRENT=$(git branch --show-current) && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: update tasks.json for branch ops' --allow-empty && git push origin HEAD && git checkout main && git pull origin main --no-rebase && git merge --no-ff "$CURRENT" -m "feat: merge $CURRENT — HUD telemetry pipeline, Windows EXE packaging, strategy engine" && git push origin main && git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0 && echo 'DONE'

tasks.label: Check GitHub Status
tasks.command: echo '=== Workflow Runs ===' && gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --limit 8 2>&1 && echo '=== Releases ===' && gh release list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --limit 5 2>&1 && echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Check Workflow Failures
tasks.command: echo '=== Release Desktop Workflow ===' && gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow release-desktop.yml --limit 3 2>&1 && echo '=== Deploy Frontend Workflow ===' && gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow deploy-frontend.yml --limit 3 2>&1 && echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: View Workflow Logs
tasks.command: echo '=== Release Desktop Latest Run Log ===' && gh run view --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --log-failed $(gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow release-desktop.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') 2>&1 | head -80; echo '---'; echo '=== Deploy Frontend Latest Run Log ===' && gh run view --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --log-failed $(gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow deploy-frontend.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') 2>&1 | head -80; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Generate Icons
tasks.command: python3 electron/icons/generate_icon.py && echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: View Deploy Frontend Log
tasks.command: gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --limit 10 --json databaseId,name,status,conclusion 2>&1 && echo '---' && gh run view --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 $(gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow deploy-frontend.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') 2>&1 | head -50; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Fix Pages Environment
tasks.command: gh api repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/environments/github-pages 2>&1 | head -30; echo '---'; gh api --method PUT repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/environments/github-pages --field deployment_branch_policy=null 2>&1; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Add Main Branch To Pages Env
tasks.command: echo 'Current branch policies:' && gh api repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/environments/github-pages/deployment-branch-policies 2>&1; echo '---Adding main branch---'; gh api --method POST repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/environments/github-pages/deployment-branch-policies --field name=main 2>&1; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Check Pages Config
tasks.command: gh api repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/pages 2>&1 && echo '---' && git -C /workspaces/f1 branch -a | grep 'gh-pages' 2>&1; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Update Pages Source
tasks.command: gh api --method PUT repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/pages --field build_type=workflow 2>&1; echo '---'; gh api repos/skywalkers-lab/f1/pages 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('source:', d.get('source')); print('build_type:', d.get('build_type'))" 2>&1; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: View CI And Other Failures
tasks.command: echo '=== CI ===' && gh run view --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --log-failed $(gh run list --repo skywalkers-lab/f1 --workflow ci.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') 2>&1 | head -60; echo EXIT_CODE=$?

tasks.label: Commit And Retag
tasks.command: git add -A && git status && git commit -m 'fix: add electron app icons, fix deploy-frontend to use gh-pages branch, add icon gen step to release workflow' && git push origin main && git tag -d v1.0.0 2>/dev/null; git push origin :refs/tags/v1.0.0 2>/dev/null; git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0 && echo 'DONE'
